dialogue.content: Hi! I started last week (hybrid, Oakland office) and my badge finally works. Which days am I actually required to be in the office? It's September 2026, if that matters.

For September 2026, you're required to be in the Oakland office **at least 3 days each week, with Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday as the anchor days**.

This comes from the May 4, 2026 People announcement ("Announcement: Three In-Office Days for Hybrid Teams," doc `people-announcement-2026-05-office-days`, lines 1–13), which took effect **2026-06-01** and explicitly replaced the older two-day (Tue/Thu) standard in both the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy (HR-110) and Section 7 of the Employee Handbook. The New Hire Onboarding Guide confirms the same 3-day / Tue–Wed–Thu expectation.

A few practical notes:
- Mondays and Fridays are optional; if you come in, book a desk in DeskSpot.
- If you can't make an anchor day, let your manager know ahead of time.

Since you're new, it's worth confirming with your manager that your role is classified as hybrid (your offer letter states this) — the 3-day rule applies to hybrid employees.
